import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import gaussian_kde

# Generate random data
np.random.seed(42)
x = np.random.randn(1000)
y = np.random.randn(1000)

# Create figure with size 7x7 inches
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 7))

# Create grid for main plot and marginal distributions
gs = fig.add_gridspec(1, 1, width_ratios=[1, 4], height_ratios=[4, 1])

# Main scatter plot
ax_main = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax_main.scatter(x, y, alpha=0.5, s=10)
ax_main.set_xlabel('x')
ax_main.set_ylabel('y')
ax_main.set_xlim(-4, 4)
ax_main.set_title('Scatter Plot with Marginal Distributions')

# X-axis marginal histogram (top)
ax_x = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0], sharex=ax_main)
ax_x.hist(x, bins=30, orientation='horizontal', color='gray', alpha=0.5)
ax_x.set_xticks([])
ax_x.set_yticks([])

# Y-axis marginal histogram (right)
ax_y = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1], sharey=ax_main)
ax_y.hist(y, bins=30, orientation='vertical', color='gray', alpha=0.5)
ax_y.set_xticks([])
ax_y.set_yticks([])

# Add suptitle
fig.suptitle('Marginal Distributions of Random Data', y=1.02)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('figure.png', dpi=100, bbox_inches='tight')
print("Figure saved as figure.png")
EOF
"}

{"command": "cat <<'EOF' > plot.py
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

rng = np.random.default_rng(19680801)
x = rng.standard_normal(1000)
y = rng.standard_normal(1000)

fig = plt.figure(figsize=(7, 7))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(2, 2, width_ratios=(4, 1), height_ratios=(1, 4), left=0.12, right=0.95, bottom=0.1, top=0.95, wspace=-0.4, hspace=-0.4)
ax = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax_histx = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0], sharex=ax)
ax_histy = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1], sharey=ax)
ax_histx.tick_params(axis="x", labelbottom=False)
ax_histy.tick_params(axis="y", labelleft=False)
ax.scatter(x, y, s=10, alpha=0.6)
binwidth = 0.25
lim = (int(max(np.abs(x).max(), np.abs(y).max()) / binwidth) + 1) * binwidth
bins = np.arange(-lim, lim + binwidth, binwidth)
ax_histx.hist(x, bins=bins)
ax_histy.hist(y, bins=bins, orientation="horizontal")
ax.set_xlim(-4, 4)
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("y")
fig.savefig("figure.png")
EOF
"}
